title: Serpent Watcher
description: A silhouetted figure with curly hair stands in the foreground of a surreal theater, gazing upward at two intertwined emerald serpents adorned with purple flowers and radiant eyes. Behind them, an audience sits in red velvet seats amid swirling pink and purple smoke, with a wooden table holding masks and cards in the left foreground.
prompt: A lone silhouetted figure with curly hair stands in a mystical theater, looking up at two large intertwined emerald green serpents with orange eyes, purple flowers growing from their bodies, and glowing halos. The serpents float dramatically against swirling pink and magenta smoke. In the background, an audience in dark clothing sits in red velvet theater seats. Foreground shows a wooden table with Venetian masks and cards. Vibrant psychedelic color palette with heavy contrast and atmospheric fog.
